title: OPEC+ Agrees to Increase Crude Oil Production by 188,000 Barrels per Day
summary: OPEC+ Agrees to Increase Crude Oil Production by 188,000 Barrels per Day

items: OPEC+ agreed to increase crude oil production by **188,000 barrels per day (bpd)** starting September 2026 (HQ: Vienna, Austria).
